headline: Late and priced: AerCap's record quarter was out before the open, and the stock is +4.5% since
reasoning: Source: AerCap's release on PR Newswire ('AerCap Holdings N.V. Reports Another Record Quarter ... and Raises 2026 Guidance'). Benzinga at 09:18 ET: 'Q3 Adj. EPS $6.56 Beats $4.16 Estimate, Sales $2.415B Beat $2.142B Estimate'. CEO call remarks followed at 09:19 and 09:23 ET. Full-year adjusted EPS guidance raised to about $20.70.
Move: 156.78 vs Tuesday's 150.02 close, +4.51% on 34,586 IEX shares. Measured from the 10:01 recap it shows only +1.5%, which is why it passed the 3% rule.
objections: Already traded +4.5% since the release; over the 3% line from the true first report.
